freeze_protocol: A maintainer reviews every value listed in requires_signoff and edits it if needed.

Set status to "frozen" and frozen to true, commit, and push to the project remote before any input listed in blinded_until_frozen is processed. The server-side push time is the pre-registration time; a local commit date is not.
After freezing, values change only through a new file (gates.v2.json) with a reason; results computed under v1 keep citing v1.
blinded_until_frozen: Main-camera share of the 29 shot times of StatsBomb match 3754079 (SN-Labels Labels-cameras.json).
Any run on the GSR holdout clips.
Box-height distributions measured on the private development clip by the archive importer.

coverage_decision.purpose: Decide whether 3D calibration of technique metrics can stay on the 720p demo match or must move to WorldPose and/or self-recorded multi-camera footage.
coverage_decision.unit: event protagonist: the player nearest the event location at the event frame. On GSR (no events, no ball) the proxy is the player nearest the image centre, and receipts must say so.
coverage_decision.formula: coverage(h) = P(event frame is main camera) * P(protagonist box height >= h px at 720p and calibration fresh | main camera)
coverage_decision.first_factor_source: SN-Labels Labels-cameras.json of the demo match. Main camera = the classes 'Main camera center', 'Main camera left' and 'Main camera right', live segments only: segments flagged as replay are excluded and a missing replay flag counts as not main. The 29 StatsBomb shot times are mapped to video time with gbf.events.align.statsbomb_video_times using the per-half offsets of runs/align-3754079/align.json.
coverage_decision.second_factor_source: GSR dev clips downscaled to 1280x720 and run through plugin-sngs with use_prev_homography=False; replaced by a detector-only measurement on the 29 shot windows once the NDA video is available.

threshold_80px.rule: If coverage(80) < 0.30, i.e. fewer than about 9 of the 29 shots are usable, the demo match keeps only body-internal angles from replay close-ups, and A-candidate 3D metrics are calibrated on WorldPose or self-recorded footage.

threshold_150px.rule: If coverage(150) < 0.10, B-tier joint-angle snapshots are not attempted on the demo match at all.

bbox_height_bins_px.note: Candidate bin edges for reporting; the 3D card minimum is set in gates.v2 after the P1 T4 benchmark.

private_clip_regression.kind: regression gate on the data used to pick the method, not a pre-registered validation
private_clip_regression.track_level_min_correct: 82 of 85 labelled tracks for every seed (historical colour result: 82/85; weighted ReID: 83/85)
private_clip_regression.detection_level_min_correct: the integer count recorded by the first P1b receipt; it must reproduce the historical 98.5% within rounding (the historical count was not saved to disk)

gsr_validation.metric: share of correctly assigned tracks and detections against GSR team-side labels, 20 seeds, mean and worst/best
gsr_validation.threshold: to be set in gates.v2 before the first GSR team run

team_clustering.off_pitch_filter: zero true players removed (hard gate); recall reported

cut_detection.private_clip: 4 of 4 cuts (18.96, 26.48, 61.44, 66.64 s) detected within one frame, no other cuts

split.rule: order clips by sha256(seed + '/' + clip_name) and take the first n

holdout.fallback: if test has no ground truth, take 12 further valid clips by the same ordering

split.match_grouping: group by match when the clip-to-match mapping is available; otherwise by clip, and say so in the receipt

gsr_evaluation.matching: per frame, Hungarian assignment on box IoU, accepted when IoU >= 0.5
gsr_evaluation.position_error: pitch metres between the predicted foot point (box bottom centre through the predicted calibration) and the ground-truth pitch position
gsr_evaluation.smoothing: the same zero-phase smoother for prediction and ground truth, parameters fitted on the smoothing_fit clips and committed before dev runs
gsr_evaluation.peak_speed_error: for each ground-truth track segment of at least 25 frames (1 s) with fresh predicted calibration: predicted peak minus ground-truth peak of the smoothed speed (peak to peak, not per-frame)
gsr_evaluation.turn_angle_and_nearest_opponent: compared as the on-screen quantity, same segments
gsr_evaluation.noise_floor: share of ground-truth speeds above 11 m/s and accelerations above 10 m/s^2, key frames and interpolated frames reported separately
gsr_evaluation.reprojection_error: only on annotated pitch-line key frames
gsr_evaluation.reporting: median and P90 with clip-level (match-level when possible) bootstrap 95% CI, 2000 resamples, seed 0; per-clip values listed; stratified by distance-to-camera terciles and by the depth direction
gsr_evaluation.p720_handling_choice: on 50 frames of each dev clip, choose between overriding image size and upsampling to 1080p by median reprojection error on annotated line key frames; within 5% prefer overriding (cheaper)

frame_identity.lossless_windows: decoded window frame k must be bit-identical to canonical source frame start+k

cross_environment.proposed_rule: for 5 sampled indices, same-index frames decoded on two environments must have mean absolute difference <= 1.0 (0-255 scale) and <= 0.25 times the mean absolute difference between that frame and its neighbours

p5_replacement.rule: The permissive perception stack becomes the default only if both ratios hold on the GSR holdout clips at 1080p and at 720p; otherwise it ships as experimental with the gap stated in the README.

deferred_to_v2: 3D card gates: minimum box height, 2D keypoint confidence, angle change within +-1 frame, reprojection error per box height (independent 2D detector), and the second-model check semantics (offline only; not_run when research mode is absent).
2D-versus-3D win criteria for each A-candidate metric.
Contact-frame module acceptance (for example at least 90% within +-1 frame).
